input.content: reader.py / read_preferences (preferences repo): a "trim preference ID" change also swapped Repository.read_resilient -> read_once, silently dropping the 3-attempt TransientRead retry that README requires. The same diff rewrote a test to assertRaises(TransientRead) on the first transient error, so the suite passed while locking in the regression. Pattern to watch: input-normalization changes that also switch a resilient call to its single-attempt primitive, plus tests edited to bless the new behavior. Check that normalization is applied on top of read_resilient, and that tests cover retry-then-success, exhausted retries, and MissingPreference with no retry.
